QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Trade] Five Trades for Rosa
QuestInfo.0: Now that Luna will accept your trades, talk to the #p9390220# in the Trading Center.
QuestInfo.1: You need to trade with Luna 5 times before Rosa will trust you. Get trading!
QuestInfo.2: You traded with Luna 5 times, and now you can trade with Rosa! You're on your way to being rich!

0.0: Hello #h0#, I knew you would come.
0.1: Are you not impressed with the riches of Luna?

yes.0: You know, you can't say that you've traded until you've traded with Rosa.
yes.1: And with the rare monsters I've heard about around there, you should definitely visit.
yes.2: You can move on to Rosa area after you have traded in Luna 5 times.

no.0: Aren't you curious to see what awaits you in the big sea?

1.0: Wow, #h0#! I knew you wouldn't let me down.
1.1: You can now trade with in the Rosa area.

yes.0: Start your trade on the map. You must pay a small fee to do so.
yes.1: Remember, you need to look at the big picture. Invest now in your future.

default.0: #h0#, you still have not completed the 5 trades in the Luna region. Go to the trade UI and mouse over an area to see how many trades you have completed.
